==Description==
The '''Gingerbread''' was the sixth enemy that appeared in [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had average health and an average speed for its debut.

==Appearance==
The '''Gingerbread''' was a toasted brown humanoid gingerbread man. It had a cylindrical head with a smiling face made and three white icing dots which resembled buttons on the front of its torso both made from white icing. It wobbled as it walked.

==Strategy==
*Area of effect towers like the [[Mortar]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Golden Pyromancer]] can be very useful against this.
*Towers with decent DPS, like the [[Ace Pilot]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Golden Soldier]] can easily deal with the '''Gingerbread'''.
